learning_objective: 🎯 [Students will identify Nouns and classify them into Proper, Common, Collective, Material, and Abstract nouns.]
warm_up_hook: 📖 Look around your room! Everything you can see, touch, or even feel has a name. These naming words are called Nouns. Let's become noun-detectives and sort them into their special categories! 🏷️

lesson_modules.teaching_content: A Common Noun is a general name for a person, place, or thing. A Proper Noun is the specific name of a particular person, place, or thing, and it always starts with a capital letter.
A Collective Noun is a word used for a group or collection of people, animals, or things. A Material Noun refers to a material or substance from which things are made.
examples_or_templates: Collective: a 'flock' of birds, an 'army' of ants

lesson_modules.teaching_content: An Abstract Noun is the name of a quality, idea, emotion, or state. You cannot physically touch or see abstract nouns—you can only feel or understand them.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Which of the following is an Abstract Noun?
❓ 'A ________ of bees flew out of the hive.' Choose the correct Collective Noun.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Circle the Proper Nouns and underline the Common Nouns: 'Ravi bought a new bicycle from the store.'
subjective_practice.hint: Look for the specific name with a capital letter, and the general names of things.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Identify the Material Noun in this sentence: 'The ring is made of pure gold.'
subjective_practice.hint: What substance is the ring made from?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Form an Abstract Noun from the adjective 'kind'.
subjective_practice.hint: Add '-ness' to the end of the word.

activity_or_assignment.title: 🔍 The Kitchen Noun Hunt
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Go to your kitchen and write down: 2 Proper Nouns (brands), 2 Common Nouns (objects), and 2 Material Nouns (substances things are made of or ingredients).

chapter_summary: ⭐ Nouns are naming words for people, places, animals, things, or ideas.
⭐ Proper nouns are specific names, while Common nouns are general names.
⭐ Collective nouns represent groups, Material nouns are substances, and Abstract nouns are feelings or ideas.
